verdict.rationale: Sift publishes a full public REST API reference covering the Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows and Webhooks APIs. The reference is versioned (v205/v204/v203) with a dated changelog listing deprecations, gives per-language request/response examples, and offers a sandbox environment with separate API keys, so its core fraud-scoring and decisioning loop can be driven programmatically. A hands-on user confirms integrating it but calls the documentation 'slightly confusing'. Missing for 10: evidence that console-side configuration (e.g. creating Workflows or managing Review Queues) can be driven via the API, plus stronger independent corroboration of the docs' quality.
